# envit

> Declarative repository context and skills for coding agents. A committed
> envit.json declares the external repos an agent can read and the skills
> it loads. One command materializes both: commit-pinned, read-only,
> stored once per machine in a content-addressed store, reproducible in
> any environment from the lockfile.

envit is a single static Rust binary. Git is embedded (gitoxide): no
system git, no daemons, plain git protocol against any forge. Repos
appear under .envit/repos/ as symlinks into the machine store. Skills
land in .agents/skills/ and .claude/skills/. A generated .envit/AGENTS.md
(with a CLAUDE.md symlink) inventories the context for agents.

Core commands: envit init | add | sync [--frozen|--offline] | update |
pin | unpin | skills | status | gc. Global scope: envit init -g writes
~/.envit/envit.json; skills apply to every project on the machine.

## Docs

- [Landing page](https://envit.dev/): manifest format, commands, on-disk
  layout, constraints
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/plannotator/envit/tree/main/skills/envit):
  teaches an agent how to use envit
- [Security](https://envit.dev/security): network and filesystem
  boundaries, release verification, vulnerability reporting

## Install

- [Unix install script](https://envit.dev/install.sh): detects OS/arch,
  installs the latest GitHub release
- [Windows](https://envit.dev/install.ps1): pending; use WSL today

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/plannotator/envit): Rust workspace,
  MIT OR Apache-2.0
